issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets and you'll win... A water tower!
issues.justification: The rhymed lottery jingle (пачку/водокачку) loses its rhyme and comic doggerel effect; 'water tower' without rhyme is flat.

issues.source_quote: Собака - друг человека! ... Управдом - друг человека!
issues.translation_quote: the building manager is man's best friend
issues.justification: Acceptable literal, but 'Управдом' pun is OK; however 'Гипрорыба' etc. unexplained. (Minor cultural flatness.)

issues.source_quote: Дичь! Он определил летний ресторан «Плакучая Ива» Строго на север... пыхты
issues.justification: 'Пихта' is a fir; 'fur tree' is a mistranslation/typo and inconsistent with later 'fir tree'. Also the deliberately comic 'туалэт, типа сортир' and 'Мэ'/'Жо' (М/Ж) joke is rendered 'M'/'W', losing the male/female letters' comedic obscenity of 'Жо'.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron's hot — before you leave the till!
issues.justification: The humor is a mangled blend of two idioms (куй железо + не отходя от кассы); the English reproduces it clumsily and the characteristic boss catchphrase loses its punch.

issues.source_quote: Поскользнулся, упал... Закрытый перелом... Потерял сознание, очнулся - гипс.
issues.translation_quote: Slipped, fell... Closed fracture... Blacked out, woke up — cast.
issues.justification: The refrain is a famous catchphrase; the translation is functional but the 'открытый перелом' punchline (closed vs open fracture, Nadya's joke) is rendered fine. Minor stylistic loss of Soviet officialese.

issues.source_quote: Нет, нет, нет, нет, нет! А я взял... Водку?
issues.justification: Gesha says he took something; the translation 'Well, I am' is garbled and loses the sense 'And I took (some)...'.
The running gag of Lyolik deliberately mangling the name Kozadoev into 'Kozlodoev' (козёл = goat/jerk) is not conveyed; the pun has no resonance in English and no gloss/compensation.
Pseudo-English gibberish ('О ес, би чел') is parodic Russian-accented English; rendering it as 'be-chel' loses the joke.
Untranslated acronym with no cultural signal; fine for subtitles but loses the comic bureaucratic ring.

issues.translation_quote: ice cream fer the kiddies, flowers fer his old lady
issues.justification: Dialect markers ('fer', 'ya', 'ev'rythin'') are inconsistently applied across the gang members and sound like American hick speech, mismatching a Soviet setting.

issues.source_quote: Такова «сё ля ви», как говорят у них...
issues.translation_quote: "C'est la vie," as they say over there...
issues.justification: Original has comic gender error ('такова сё ля ви') and mispronunciation; lost.

issues.source_quote: Вам нужно обязательно встретиться с Вашим приятелем
issues.justification: Fine; but 'Обои!... Убью!' rendered 'Both of ya!... I'll kill ya!' shifts register.
'Так надо!' is a curt colloquial 'It has to be done / Just do it'; 'necessary' sounds stiff.

issues.source_quote: Бандит! ... Не взял попутных - это не таксист!
issues.translation_quote: Won't pick up passengers — he's no taxi driver!
issues.justification: 'Попутных' means fares/passengers going the same way, hence suspicion; translation loses nuance but acceptable. Also 'Stop, let's pick them up!' is unclear.
Invented spelling does not reproduce the foreign-sounding pun and reads as an odd pun on 'fool'.
Fine, but 'отключим газ' double meaning of 'газ/газеты' is not an issue; skip. Note 'Hang around the consignment shops... The train station? Go there too' adds an inserted question not in source.

issues.source_quote: Дела есть у нас, В самый жуткий час Мы волшебную Косим трынь траву.
issues.justification: The pun on 'трынь-трава' (a magic herb and idiom for 'don't care') is rendered with an awkward coinage; later 'all troubles will be like grass to us' loses the idiom.

issues.source_quote: Не виноватая я! Он сам пришёл!
issues.translation_quote: I ain't to blame! He come on his own!
issues.justification: Substandard grammar overdone and register not matching a hotel guest's colloquial Russian.
